tables.name: public.users
tables.comment: Customers and cinema admins. Email is stored lower-cased.

columns.name: password_hash
columns.comment: bcrypt hash, never the plain password

indexes.name: users_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_pkey ON public.users USING btree (id)

indexes.name: users_email_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_email_key ON public.users USING btree (email)

tables.name: public.cities
tables.comment: Cities the cinema chain operates in

indexes.name: cities_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cities_pkey ON public.cities USING btree (id)

indexes.name: cities_name_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cities_name_key ON public.cities USING btree (name)

tables.name: public.cinemas
tables.comment: A branch of the chain in a city

indexes.name: cinemas_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cinemas_pkey ON public.cinemas USING btree (id)

indexes.name: cinemas_city_id_name_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cinemas_city_id_name_key ON public.cinemas USING btree (city_id, name)

tables.name: public.studios
tables.comment: A screening room inside a cinema

indexes.name: studios_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX studios_pkey ON public.studios USING btree (id)

indexes.name: studios_cinema_id_name_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX studios_cinema_id_name_key ON public.studios USING btree (cinema_id, name)

tables.name: public.seats
tables.comment: Physical seat layout of a studio, e.g. row A seat 5

indexes.name: seats_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX seats_pkey ON public.seats USING btree (id)

indexes.name: seats_studio_id_row_label_seat_number_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX seats_studio_id_row_label_seat_number_key ON public.seats USING btree (studio_id, row_label, seat_number)

indexes.name: movies_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX movies_pkey ON public.movies USING btree (id)

tables.name: public.showtimes
tables.comment: Jadwal tayang: one movie in one studio at one time

columns.name: end_at
columns.comment: start_at + movie duration, set by the API

columns.name: studio_free_at
columns.comment: end_at + 15 minutes of cleaning; the next showtime may start from here

indexes.name: showtimes_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX showtimes_pkey ON public.showtimes USING btree (id)

indexes.name: showtimes_no_overlap
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX showtimes_no_overlap ON public.showtimes USING gist (studio_id, tstzrange(start_at, studio_free_at)) WHERE ((status)::text = 'SCHEDULED'::text)

indexes.name: showtimes_movie_id_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX showtimes_movie_id_idx ON public.showtimes USING btree (movie_id)

indexes.name: showtimes_start_at_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX showtimes_start_at_idx ON public.showtimes USING btree (start_at)

constraints.name: showtimes_no_overlap
constraints.def: EXCLUDE USING gist (studio_id WITH =, tstzrange(start_at, studio_free_at) WITH &&) WHERE (((status)::text = 'SCHEDULED'::text))

tables.name: public.bookings
tables.comment: A customer order. PENDING_PAYMENT holds its seats until expires_at

columns.name: expires_at
columns.comment: Payment deadline; 1 minute after it (grace period) the held seats are free again

indexes.name: bookings_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bookings_pkey ON public.bookings USING btree (id)

indexes.name: bookings_booking_code_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bookings_booking_code_key ON public.bookings USING btree (booking_code)

indexes.name: bookings_id_showtime_id_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bookings_id_showtime_id_key ON public.bookings USING btree (id, showtime_id)

indexes.name: bookings_user_id_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX bookings_user_id_idx ON public.bookings USING btree (user_id)

indexes.name: bookings_showtime_id_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX bookings_showtime_id_idx ON public.bookings USING btree (showtime_id)

constraints.name: bookings_status_check
constraints.def: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDING_PAYMENT'::character varying, 'PAID'::character varying, 'EXPIRED'::character varying, 'REFUNDED'::character varying])::text[])))

tables.name: public.showtime_seats
tables.comment: Seat stock per showtime, generated when the showtime is created

columns.name: booking_id
columns.comment: Booking holding the seat. NULL, or a booking that is EXPIRED/REFUNDED/over 1 minute past expires_at, means available

indexes.name: showtime_seats_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX showtime_seats_pkey ON public.showtime_seats USING btree (showtime_id, seat_id)

indexes.name: showtime_seats_booking_id_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX showtime_seats_booking_id_idx ON public.showtime_seats USING btree (booking_id)

constraints.name: showtime_seats_showtime_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (showtime_id) REFERENCES showtimes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: showtime_seats_booking_id_showtime_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (booking_id, showtime_id) REFERENCES bookings(id, showtime_id)

tables.name: public.tickets
tables.comment: Issued once a booking is PAID; VOID after a refund

indexes.name: tickets_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tickets_pkey ON public.tickets USING btree (id)

indexes.name: tickets_one_active_per_seat
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tickets_one_active_per_seat ON public.tickets USING btree (showtime_id, seat_id) WHERE ((status)::text = 'ACTIVE'::text)

indexes.name: tickets_booking_id_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX tickets_booking_id_idx ON public.tickets USING btree (booking_id)

constraints.name: tickets_booking_id_showtime_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (booking_id, showtime_id) REFERENCES bookings(id, showtime_id)

constraints.name: tickets_showtime_id_seat_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (showtime_id, seat_id) REFERENCES showtime_seats(showtime_id, seat_id)

columns.name: provider_ref
columns.comment: Transaction id from the payment gateway; UNIQUE makes callbacks idempotent

indexes.name: payments_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payments_pkey ON public.payments USING btree (id)

indexes.name: payments_provider_ref_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payments_provider_ref_key ON public.payments USING btree (provider_ref)

indexes.name: payments_booking_id_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX payments_booking_id_idx ON public.payments USING btree (booking_id)

tables.name: public.refunds
tables.comment: Money returned to the customer, e.g. when the cinema cancels a showtime

indexes.name: refunds_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX refunds_pkey ON public.refunds USING btree (id)

indexes.name: refunds_payment_id_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX refunds_payment_id_idx ON public.refunds USING btree (payment_id)

relations.def: FOREIGN KEY (showtime_id) REFERENCES showtimes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (booking_id, showtime_id) REFERENCES bookings(id, showtime_id)
FOREIGN KEY (booking_id, showtime_id) REFERENCES bookings(id, showtime_id)
FOREIGN KEY (showtime_id, seat_id) REFERENCES showtime_seats(showtime_id, seat_id)
